title: a plain `if` / `else if` / `else` in workflow creates, an `on` reactor, an event-triggered starter and a `commandHandler`
note: Each branch saves every row it changes at its own end, including a row loaded before the `if`, so a row the taken branch leaves alone keeps its version.  On elixir the `if` threads a handle its branch changed back out — `Bump`'s second `if` reads the row the first one bumped, the witness that it does.
